info.title: Moovha Wallet Provider Service
info.description: Experimental wallet-provider API. Configured deployments use one Safe account per user, private ERC-4337 v0.7 bundling and an application-owned verifying paymaster. Applications submit policy-approved calls through the account wallet endpoint and observe independently verified inclusion. Current owner, identity, consent, immutable calls and durable attempt authority precede effects. Acknowledgement, wallet inclusion and business settlement are distinct. Not the Moovha operation orchestration API.

post.description: Reserve an owner-enrollment challenge through current host policy and durable storage. No wallet is created.
Submit a provider-nonce-bound OIDC Identity Assurance ID token. Provider policy decides acceptance; this never creates a wallet or spend grant.

get.description: Read the current authorized enrollment receipt without identity attributes or the proof token.

post.description: Provision a host-authorized account by stored ID with an empty body and durable attempt. When enrollment is configured, current provider acceptance for the same caller/account/owner is also required. Acceptance does not grant signing rights.

user.description: Required in application-led mode. The explicitly trusted application attests its stable user identity and recorded consent; OAuth scopes alone do not establish these facts.

consent_url.description: Hosted compatibility only. Application-led grants have no provider user redirect.

get.description: Authenticated bounded SSE status stream. Sends current account-authorized EIP-5792 status after durable observation changes. Reconnect after 55 seconds; ordinary status reads remain available.

200.description: Bounded SSE stream of authorized wallet status

post.description: Optional account-scoped EIP-5792 2.0.0 JSON-RPC transport. Runtime financial authority, the Safe ERC-4337 driver, current owner consent and method-specific scopes remain required. wallet_sendCalls admits a durable atomic batch without waiting for chain inclusion. Headless wallet_showCallsStatus returns unsupported method; the client adapter can present status through an explicit host callback.

schema.description: Single account-scoped JSON-RPC request. SendCallsParams uses EIP-5792 version 2.0.0. JSON-RPC batch envelopes and notifications are not accepted.

requestBody.description: Single account-scoped JSON-RPC request. SendCallsParams uses EIP-5792 version 2.0.0. JSON-RPC batch envelopes and notifications are not accepted.

get.description: Optional runtime configuration control plane. Application proposals and provider publications are configuration records, not wallet grants, signing authority or execution activation. Publications become readable immediately without restarting the service. Immutable historical revisions remain available. Requires the documented scope and configured application or operator identity.

put.description: Store or rotate an application-owned HTTPS service endpoint in encrypted storage. Send null to revoke it. Secret paths are never returned. Associated service declarations require provider review after every change.

get.description: Protected, application-scoped declarations and provider decisions. Accepted actions constrain off-chain payloads. Accepted service declarations permit resolving application-owned verifier credentials when credential storage is configured. Acceptance does not fund gas, provision a user Safe, activate execution or authorize spending. User assets remain in individual user wallets. Secrets and actual user payloads must not be submitted here.

credential_reference.description: Opaque application-local secret-store reference. Never a credential, URL, environment-variable lookup or authority to read another application’s secret. Runtime resolution is not enabled by registration.
